## Install

1. Download **RIROTE-VISION-…-mac.dmg** below. It works on Apple Silicon and Intel Macs running macOS 13 or later.
2. Open it and drag **RIROTE VISION** into **Applications**.
3. Open the app. macOS blocks it the first time, because it is not signed by an Apple developer account. Go to **System Settings > Privacy & Security**, scroll down, click **Open Anyway** next to RIROTE VISION, and confirm.
4. In the app, choose **RIROTE VISION > Check Setup…** and install what it offers.

You also need [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) signed in with your own Claude plan, Node.js 22 or later and FFmpeg. See the [README](https://github.com/rishabhsisodiya/rirote-vision#what-you-need) for details.

This is an early build that has been tested on one Mac. Please open an issue for anything that goes wrong.
